tools.name: create_log_group
tools.description: Create a new Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group

logGroupName.description: A name for the log group.

kmsKeyId.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the KMS key to use when encrypting log data.

tags.description: The key-value pairs to use for the tags.

logGroupClass.description: Use this parameter to specify the log group class for this log group.

tools.name: describe_log_groups
tools.description: List and describe Amazon CloudWatch Logs log groups

accountIdentifiers.description: When `includeLinkedAccounts` is set to `True`, use this parameter to specify the list of accounts to search.

logGroupNamePattern.description: If you specify a string for this parameter, the operation returns only log groups that have names that match the string based on a case-sensitive substring search.

nextToken.description: The token for the next set of items to return.

limit.description: The maximum number of items returned.

includeLinkedAccounts.description: If you are using a monitoring account, set this to `True` to have the operation return log groups in the accounts listed in `accountIdentifiers`.

logGroupClass.description: Specifies the log group class for this log group

tools.name: delete_log_group
tools.description: Delete an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group

logGroupName.description: The name of the log group.

tools.name: create_log_stream
tools.description: Create a new log stream in an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group

logGroupName.description: The name of the log group.

logStreamName.description: The name of the log stream.

tools.name: describe_log_streams
tools.description: List and describe log streams in an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group

logGroupName.description: The name of the log group.

logGroupIdentifier.description: Specify either the name or ARN of the log group to view.

orderBy.description: If the value is `LogStreamName`, the results are ordered by log stream name.

descending.description: If the value is true, results are returned in descending order.

nextToken.description: The token for the next set of items to return.

limit.description: The maximum number of items returned.

tools.name: delete_log_stream
tools.description: Delete a log stream in an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group

logGroupName.description: The name of the log group.

logStreamName.description: The name of the log stream.

tools.name: put_log_events
tools.description: Write log events to a specified log stream in Amazon CloudWatch Logs

logGroupName.description: The name of the log group.

logStreamName.description: The name of the log stream.

timestamp.description: The time the event occurred, expressed as the number of milliseconds after Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

sequenceToken.description: The sequence token obtained from the response of the previous `PutLogEvents` call.

keyAttributes.description: The attributes of the entity which identify the specific entity, as a list of key-value pairs.

attributes.description: Additional attributes of the entity that are not used to specify the identity of the entity.

entity.description: The entity associated with the log events.

tools.name: get_log_events
tools.description: Retrieve log events from a specified log stream in Amazon CloudWatch Logs

logGroupName.description: The name of the log group.

logGroupIdentifier.description: Specify either the name or ARN of the log group to view events from.

logStreamName.description: The name of the log stream.

startTime.description: The start of the time range, expressed as the number of milliseconds after Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

endTime.description: The end of the time range, expressed as the number of milliseconds after Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

nextToken.description: The token for the next set of items to return.

limit.description: The maximum number of log events returned.

startFromHead.description: If the value is true, the earliest log events are returned first. If the value is false, the latest log events are returned first.

unmask.description: Specify true to display the log event fields with all sensitive data unmasked and visible.

tools.name: filter_log_events
tools.description: Search log events with a pattern across log groups and streams in Amazon CloudWatch Logs

logGroupName.description: The name of the log group to search.

logGroupIdentifier.description: Specify either the name or ARN of the log group to view log events from.

logStreamNames.description: Filters the results to only logs from the log streams in this list.

logStreamNamePrefix.description: Filters the results to include only events from log streams that have names starting with this prefix.

startTime.description: The start of the time range, expressed as the number of milliseconds after Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

endTime.description: The end of the time range, expressed as the number of milliseconds after Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

nextToken.description: The token for the next set of events to return.

limit.description: The maximum number of events to return.

unmask.description: Specify true to display the log event fields with all sensitive data unmasked and visible.

tools.name: start_query
tools.description: Start a CloudWatch Logs Insights query

queryLanguage.description: Specify the query language to use for this query.

logGroupName.description: The log group on which to perform the query.

logGroupNames.description: The list of log groups to be queried.

logGroupIdentifiers.description: The list of log groups to query.

startTime.description: The beginning of the time range to query.

endTime.description: The end of the time range to query.

limit.description: The maximum number of log events to return in the query.

tools.name: stop_query
tools.description: Stop a running CloudWatch Logs Insights query

queryId.description: The ID number of the query to stop.

tools.name: get_query_results
tools.description: Retrieve the results of a CloudWatch Logs Insights query

queryId.description: The ID number of the query.

tools.name: describe_queries
tools.description: List and describe CloudWatch Logs Insights queries

logGroupName.description: Limits the returned queries to only those for the specified log group.

status.description: Limits the returned queries to only those that have the specified status.

maxResults.description: Limits the number of returned queries to the specified number.

nextToken.description: The token for the next set of items to return.

queryLanguage.description: Limits the returned queries to only the queries that use the specified query language.
